subject: ela
skillName: Point of View and Cultural Experience
intro: Analyze point of view and cultural experience.

items.prompt:
Literature from a particular culture reflects that culture's:
A) values and viewpoint
B) page count
C) font

Reading literature from other countries broadens your:
A) perspective
B) handwriting
C) shoe size

Whose eyes a story is told through is its:
A) point of view
B) title
C) length

A famine is narrated by a child who doesn't grasp the adults' fear. This point of view:
A) heightens the fear and innocence of the telling
B) removes all emotion
C) has no effect
items.answer: A) heightens the fear and innocence of the telling

steps: Limited child's view. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) heightens the fear and innocence of the telling

items.prompt:
Why read literature from OUTSIDE your own country?
A) to understand values and perspectives from other cultures
B) to avoid new ideas
C) to read less
items.answer: A) to understand values and perspectives from other cultures

solution.answer: A) to understand values and perspectives from other cultures

items.prompt:
A story where elders make all major family decisions reflects a cultural value of:
A) deference to elders
B) individualism only
C) nothing

steps: Respect for age. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

A novel told from a servant's point of view notices the wealthy family's wastefulness that the family itself never sees.

This point of view mainly:
A) exposes the family's blind spots through the servant's perspective
B) proves the servant is wrong
C) has no perspective
items.answer: A) exposes the family's blind spots through the servant's perspective

steps: POV reveals what insiders miss. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) exposes the family's blind spots through the servant's perspective

items.prompt:
Analyzing the cultural experience in world literature mainly helps a reader:
A) understand values and perspectives different from their own
B) assume all cultures are identical
C) ignore the setting
items.answer: A) understand values and perspectives different from their own

steps: Builds cultural awareness. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) understand values and perspectives different from their own
